State Treasurer State Of Michigan Continues to Hold Stake in Lennar (LEN); Sadoff Investment Management Increases Stake in Citigroup (C)
May 31, 2018 - By Winifred Garcia
State Treasurer State Of Michigan increased its stake in Lennar Corp (LEN) by 34.02% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. State Treasurer State Of Michigan bought 20,400 shares as the company’s stock declined 10.19% with the market. The institutional investor held 80,358 shares of the homebuilding company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $4.74M, up from 59,958 at the end of the previous reported quarter. State Treasurer State Of Michigan who had been investing in Lennar Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $16.74B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.01% or $0.53 during the last trading session, reaching $51.97. About 919,838 shares traded. Lennar Corporation (NYSE:LEN) has risen 5.00% since May 31, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 7.57% the S&P500.
Sadoff Investment Management Llc increased its stake in Citigroup Inc (C) by 1.35% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Sadoff Investment Management Llc bought 8,204 shares as the company’s stock declined 11.86% with the market. The institutional investor held 615,565 shares of the major banks company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $41.55M, up from 607,361 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Sadoff Investment Management Llc who had been investing in Citigroup Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $169.14 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.52% or $0.35 during the last trading session, reaching $66.33. About 8.46M shares traded. Citigroup Inc. (NYSE:C) has risen 10.48% since May 31, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 2.09% the S&P500.
State Treasurer State Of Michigan, which manages about $12.42 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Procter And Gamble Co (NYSE:PG) by 1.09 million shares to 1.11M shares, valued at $88.26 million in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Verizon Communications Inc (NYSE:VZ) by 3.75 million shares in the quarter, leaving it with 2.91 million shares, and cut its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL).
